accounts.name: table
docs: after the scheduler CPI.

accounts.name: table
docs: after the scheduler CPI.

accounts.name: scheduler
docs: The account that scheduled the crank task. Any key may schedule (`rearm_ticks` is
permissionless); the signer below proves the call came from the scheduler.

errors.name: WrongPhase
errors.msg: The table is not in the phase this instruction needs

errors.name: SeatTaken
errors.msg: The seat is taken and cannot be displaced

errors.name: NotSeatOwner
errors.msg: Only the seat owner may do this

errors.name: NotAuthority
errors.msg: Only the table authority may do this

errors.name: VrfPending
errors.msg: A VRF request is already pending

errors.name: VrfNotTimedOut
errors.msg: The VRF request has not timed out yet

errors.name: StaleVrfCallback
errors.msg: The callback does not match the pending request

errors.name: NotRearmable
errors.msg: The crank is still armed; nothing to re-arm

types.name: AnalystStats
docs: Track record of one analyst seat, judged by the oracle (public, on chain).

types.name: CallBook
docs: One Call per seat.

types.name: CallHeader
docs: Public header of a Desk Call; the direction and confidence stay in the private `CallVault`
until settlement reveals the direction. Zero-copy: the call book is 1.8 KB, too big for the
4 KB SBF stack frame when deserialised the normal way.

fields.name: state
docs: `CallState` as a byte.

fields.name: revealed_dir
docs: Revealed direction after settlement: +1 up, -1 down, 0 not revealed.

fields.name: minted_price
docs: Oracle price at mint, fixed point 1e6 (decoded with the feed-list exponent).

types.name: Fill
docs: A fill executed against the vAMM (public by design).

fields.name: seat
docs: 255 = whale.

fields.name: side
docs: +1 buy, -1 sell.

fields.name: price
docs: Average fill price, fixed point 1e6.

types.name: Params
docs: Market parameters the engine reads (spec sections 7.1-7.2). Stored on `Table` so gate E1 can
tune them without a program change.

fields.name: arb_bps
docs: Arbitrage pull per tick toward the fundamental, in basis points (start 400 = 4%).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Trading fee in basis points (10 = 0.1%).

fields.name: priority_fee
docs: Priority-lane fee in chips.

fields.name: standard_delay
docs: Ticks until a standard order lands.

fields.name: priority_delay
docs: Ticks until a priority order lands.

fields.name: max_order_units
docs: Largest order in units.

fields.name: max_position_units
docs: Largest absolute position in units.

fields.name: max_pending
docs: Most pending orders per seat.

fields.name: vamm_base
docs: Virtual reserves reset every round.

types.name: Phase
docs: Round phase. `Live` accepts orders; `Closing` drains the mempool and closes positions.

types.name: Season
docs: Epoch state, delegated and committed separately from the table accounts (spec section 6).

fields.name: leaderboard
docs: Best scores of the epoch, highest first; empty slots have a default owner.

types.name: Seat
docs: One of the ten seats. Public: owner, chips, position and activity are visible to everyone.

fields.name: index
docs: Seat number 0-9 (also in the PDA seeds).

fields.name: owner
docs: Wallet or guest key that holds the seat; the default key means the seat is free.

fields.name: name_idx
docs: Index into the fixed name list (no free text on chain).

fields.name: position
docs: Signed position in units.

fields.name: entry
docs: Average entry price, fixed point 1e6.

fields.name: claims
docs: How many times the seat has been claimed.

types.name: SendEvent
docs: Public trace of an order being sent: who, in which lane, when. The order's side and size are
never here; they live in the private mempool.

fields.name: lane
docs: 0 = standard, 1 = priority.

types.name: Table
docs: The one public table account: who runs it, which round and phase, and the automation state.

fields.name: round_start_slot
docs: Rollup slot at which tick 0 of the current round began.

fields.name: tick
docs: Last tick processed in this round (see `SLOTS_PER_TICK`).

fields.name: armed_until_slot
docs: Slot at which the scheduled crank stops; `rearm_ticks` extends it.

fields.name: vrf_nonce
docs: Incremented per VRF request so a late callback for an old request is rejected.

fields.name: vrf_requested_tick
docs: Tick at which the pending VRF request was made (for `cancel_vrf`).

types.name: Tape
docs: Two fixed ring buffers; `*_head` counts every push, so the newest entry is at
`(head - 1) % RING`.
